title: Even when you fail on the way
header_line: My analysis of one book on an entrepreneur's life. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: This is a story, not a lesson. Read it and think about a failure of your own.

groups.heading: Out of ten things, I failed nine

lines.text: I've had extremely low lows, I said. I joke with you guys: out of the ten things I've done in my life, I think I failed nine.
I told of a digital advertising agency I started in my twenties. I thought it was going to do very well. It ended up not working out.

But then it became part of my business model in whatever I do, I said. I never thought: I'm never going to use this again. Even if it fails, it is part of my skill set. It is part of the process of where I want to go.
When I later ran a fishing tourism business, I said, digital advertising was how I got my clients to come fishing and pay.

groups.heading: Even when you fail on the way

lines.text: Everything you do on the way, even when you fail on the way, the process and what you are learning is the most important thing, I said.
Put things into perspective and remove yourself from the emotional roller coaster. Ask: what am I going to think about this in ten years?
You have to control the lows, I said. You cannot let your mind go there. What kind of decisions are you going to make in your lows?
What did one of your failures give you that you still use?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write one thing you tried that did not work out.
Write one skill or lesson you still use from it.
Write where you could use it next.
Write what you will think about this failure in ten years.

check.q: How many of ten things did I joke I failed?
What happened to the failed digital advertising agency, in my story?
choices: It became part of my business model

check.q: What question did I say to ask to gain perspective?
choices: What am I going to think about this in ten years?

recap: Even a failure leaves a skill. Keep what you learn on the way.
